biggest_catch: Rewards are paid 90 days after the membership open date — a long payout lag for a $50 referral.
catches: Rewards are paid 90 days after the membership open date, only once qualification requirements are met.
The referred person must not currently have, and never previously had, a Premier membership (including as joint owner or co-borrower).
The friend must name the referrer at membership opening; retroactive referrals are not accepted.
Both members must be in good standing to receive a payout.
Rewards beyond the base membership path depend on loan/card qualification (loan option: $10,000+ qualifying loan).

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Premier Credit Union's official member-referral page (premiercu.org/member-referral/) pays the referring member $50 and the new member $50.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: $50 is paid to the referring member and $50 to the new member once the friend opens a membership and qualifies within the 90-day window.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: an existing Premier member introduces a new person; the friend provides the referrer's name at membership opening so the referral is tracked.

c4.evidence: Timing: rewards are processed 90 days after the membership open date.

eligibility: Eligible existing Premier Credit Union members referring new members with no current or prior Premier membership.
notes: Premier Credit Union (premiercu.org). Base referral: $50 each. Thin-terms caveat on full qualification set beyond membership opening.
payout_quote: After 90 days from membership opening date, rewards are processed. $50 is paid to the referring member and $50 is paid to the new member.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the observed snippet.

s4.note: Annual cap not disclosed on the observed snippet.

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23).

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: introduce someone new; the friend provides the referrer's name during application/membership opening.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: open a Premier membership within the 90-day window, meet qualification requirements, and name the referrer at opening.

steps: Introduce a friend to Premier Credit Union.
Friend opens a membership within the 90-day window and names you as the referrer at opening.
90 days after the membership open date, rewards are processed: $50 to you and $50 to the new member.
timing: 90 days after the membership open date.
